name: ACT
summary: Retired ground-based high-resolution CMB telescope using temperature, polarization and CMB lensing to constrain dark matter and structure growth.
detection_principle: Cryogenic millimeter-wave detectors scan the sky. Multifrequency foreground removal and statistical reconstruction yield CMB power spectra and lensing mass fields.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: The website explicitly states that final data were collected in 2022 and the telescope is retired.

timeline.event: DR6 cosmological maps and results released

collaboration.name: ACT collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

results.summary: DR6 provides high-resolution CMB data constraining matter and dark-matter components.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
